title: Masking Isn't Pretending, It's Survival
content:
What does "masking" mean for autistic people? MeFite brookhorse answers that question with vivid stories from childhood, showing the constant effort behind every expression, glance, and tone.

Take a few minutes and read this eye-opening comment. It'll change the way you think about what autistic people go through every day
author: Brandon Blatcher
